_source.title: 设置为新建 PCB 默认物理叠层配置
_source.remarks.text.0: 返回值为结果导向，重复设置相同的物理叠层为默认物理叠层也将返回 `true`
_source.params.physicalProps: 物理属性，如若不传入则默认为当前 PCB 属性

title: Set as the default physical stacking configuration for new PCBs
remarks.text.0: The return value is result-oriented. Repeatedly setting the same physical stacking as the default will also return `true`
params.physicalProps: Physical properties. If not passed in, the current PCB properties are used by default
